title: Maximum Total Sum of K Selected Elements
summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers k and mul, select exactly k elements from nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums and two integers k and mul, select exactly k elements from nums. For each selected element, independently choose to either add its value to the total sum or multiply it by the current value of mul and then add the result to the total sum. After processing each element, mul decreases by 1, and can become 0 or negative. Return the maximum possible total sum.
constraints: Select exactly k values; successive chosen values may be multiplied by current mul, which decreases by one, or left unchanged.
hints: All effective multipliers are at least one and nonincreasing.
Choose the k largest values and pair the largest values with the largest multipliers.
Exchange arguments improve any plan that omits a larger value or pairs larger value with smaller factor.
editorial: Exchange arguments improve any plan that omits a larger value or pairs larger value with smaller factor.

tests.explanation: Use the largest values with effective factors two, one, and one: 18+6+2=26.
Assign factors four and three to values three and two, totaling eighteen.
